decision_question: Are the dream specification and delivery roadmap safe and useful to guide controlled Stage 0 discovery and bounded Stage 1 design?
acceptance_criteria: Human-controlled consent, canon, and AI boundaries
Safe ingestion, portability, restriction, and recovery gates
Traceable requirements and testable completion evidence

shared_model_or_source_limits: All reviewers are agents using the same local repository and overlapping model context.
No external holdout, live user test, security test, legal review, or deployment evidence was available.

concordance: initial reviewers agreed on a constrained design-only approval

falsification_hypotheses: Private source deletion can fail across logs, Git, caches, exports, and backups.
No safe terminal disposition exists for restricted or withdrawn work.
Generic processing consent can be misread as derivative consent.
Revocation can affect descendants and co-created outputs.
Export does not prove portability or privacy.
Stage 1 records may make later governance impossible.
Untrusted upload processing can violate confidentiality and safety.
Missing traceability permits false stage completion.
test_results: Not run. Credible counterexamples became explicit design gates.

decisive_evidence: Frozen documents label target-state requirements as Proposed or Open.
Existing open decisions and policy boundaries block unsafe implementation assumptions.
Credible falsification hypotheses identify requirements that can be added now and evidence that must be obtained later.
unresolved_items: Qualified legal input for rights-sensitive terms
Portable-archive restore test and real-user Stage 1 test

limitations: Use only for controlled discovery and bounded design.
Do not accept real untrusted uploads, open public contribution, or enable derivative transformations of other people's material.
Do not treat analytical review as deployment, legal, security, or usability evidence.
follow_up: Create a Stage 0/1 traceability matrix and dated capability inventory.
Define default-deny action-specific consent and descendant lineage.
Approve and test the untrusted-upload contract.
Add gated CIE/PIE delivery evidence and prove portability through restoration.
